parameters.query:
=UPDATE token 
SET token_value = CASE 
    WHEN token_type = 'access' THEN '{{ $json.access.token }}'
    WHEN token_type = 'refresh' THEN '{{ $json.refresh.token }}'
    END,
expires_at = CASE 
    WHEN token_type = 'access' THEN NOW() + INTERVAL '{{ $json.access.ttl }} seconds'
    WHEN token_type = 'refresh' THEN NOW() + INTERVAL '{{ $json.refresh.ttl }} seconds'
    END
WHERE phone = '{{ $json.phone }}';
